commonPrompt: Create ONE polished hand-painted raster game asset for Age of Fronts: a Russian-culture Stone Age building compound. CAMERA CRITICAL: exactly vertical 90-degree nadir orthographic TOP VIEW, like a roof plan, no isometric projection, no camera tilt, no perspective, no horizon. See roof surfaces and yard surfaces; NO visible building facades, front doors, window elevations, fence side faces or front-facing gables. Shapes on the ground have equal front and rear scale. All circular horizontal shapes are perfect circles. One centered square canvas, compound occupies about 80 percent of width and height, with generous true transparent alpha margins on ALL sides. Natural footprint tailored to the building role; do not wrap every building in a circular palisade. Crisp, richly textured but visually simplified professional RTS art, clear medium-size shapes that remain identifiable at 64 and 128 pixels. Natural warm oak-brown timber, pale wheat-gold thatch, muted olive moss, ochre packed dirt and grey stone, with restrained top-left lighting and tiny contact shadows. No text, letters, HUD icons, labels, watermark, black background, fake checkerboard, scenic landscape, people, snowy ground, decorative oversized trees or extra panels. All silhouettes entirely contained. Genuine transparent background.
